tests.title: A new product published in the CRM appears on the eShop with its price, options and stock
tests.goal: Staff can launch a product and customers can buy it straight away.
preconditions: A QA product we create (not hidden), with 2 variants, a category and stock moved in by transfer
data: Price and variants chosen at runtime

steps.text: Create and save the product visible on Online Shop
Open its category and search on the eShop
Open the product page and add each variant

expected.text: The product is listed in its category and search with the CRM price
Variants and stock match; a variant with 0 stock shows SOLD OUT
Cleanup: terminate the product (ask: terminate is @final, see SCRM-002)
